notes.title: Update #2: Now Supports Japanese and Chinese(traditional) Languages!
notes.notes:
Welcome Japan & Taiwan!
Mold on Pizza Deluxe now supports Japanese and Chinese(traditional) languages.

- Japanese language
- Chinese language (traditional)
- 日本語
- 中文(繁體)

We hope you enjoy Mold on Pizza Deluxe!

notes.title: Update #1: Windows 10 support, Improved UI, and more!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

- Windows 10 support
- Large Pizza Level design
- Add Large Pizza AIs
- Emmental's HP 120% up!
- Emmental's Knock-Back 120% up!
- Mozzarella's Knock-Back 120% up!
- Moldragon restore HP when eat Preservatives now
- Some bug fixed

We hope you enjoy the update!

notes.title: Mold on Pizza Deluxe is now available!
notes.notes:
Mold on Pizza Deluxe is now available on Steam for PC, Mac & Linux. The game contains english and russian on the release. More languages will be made available in the upcoming weeks, so stay tuned for that! 

We are currently offering a 20% launch discount.

Make sure to support us by leaving a review of the game on our store page, we greatly appreciate all the help and support you all have given us!

More information
Facebook: http://facebook.com/moldonpizza
